purpose: A valid finding where a naive suffix match breaks an existing test, so running the tests decides the fix.

pull_request.title: fix(github): treat a PR without check runs as a state, not an API failure
pull_request.body:
## Summary

- Read `gh pr checks` exits by their stdout/stderr shape so a PR without check runs is a state, not an API failure.

## Validation

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`

commits.message: fix(github): classify gh pr checks results by output shape

reference.message: fix(github): match gh.exe and Windows paths in is_pr_checks_command

items.summary: Match the executable after either path separator, case-insensitively, as gh or gh.exe.
items.why: The package is OS independent; Windows commands are often gh.exe with backslash paths.
